name: TX-33
label: Safe D

key_factors: Colin Allred's large fundraising advantage and name recognition
Open seat after Crockett's Senate run, but seat stays with Democrats
model.rationale: TX-33's D+18 partisan lean makes this a heavily Democratic district even with Jasmine Crockett off the ballot, and Colin Allred — a well-known former Senate nominee — has raised over $7 million against a Republican opponent with no reported fundraising. Markets price Democrats around 96%, consistent with a Safe D rating.
model.watch: Any sign of Allred underperforming the district's lean in late polling, or unexpected Republican outside spending, would be the first signal of a closer race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.
Open seat: Jasmine Crockett (D) is not on the ballot.

overview:
TX-33 is a heavily Democratic Dallas-area seat opening up as Jasmine Crockett runs for Senate. Former Rep. Colin Allred, the 2024 Senate nominee, enters as the Democratic favorite with strong name recognition and more than $7 million raised. Republican Patrick Gillespie has reported little or no fundraising, and no outside groups are active against Allred.

The district's D+18 partisan lean and prediction markets pricing Democrats near 96% point to the seat staying safely in Democratic hands despite the open-seat dynamic. The main residual uncertainty is typical open-seat variance rather than any specific evidence of a competitive race.
